title: Wind Archer — complete skill frame set
source: maplestory.io, GMS version 270 (skillbook API for jobs 1300/1310/1311/1312/1314; WZ API for V/HEXA)

skills.name: Whispers of the Wind
skills.description: Whispers of the wind teach you ancient knowledge of body and mind.

skills.name: Breeze Arrow
skills.description: Fires off a wind-infused arrow.

skills.name: Wind Walk
skills.description: Your arrows walk on the wind, flying straight through any monsters they touch.

skills.name: Storm Elemental
skills.description: Gain the power of a wind elemental.

skills.name: Gust Swift
skills.description: Allows you to double jump. Press the up key at the same time to move upward.

skills.name: Agile Bows
skills.description: Increases Attack Speed and Dexterity.

skills.name: Bow Mastery
skills.description: Increases Bow Mastery and Final Damage.

skills.name: Physical Training
skills.description: Permanently increases STR and DEX through sheer physical training.

skills.name: Trifling Wind I
skills.description: Summons the Spirit of Wind to confuse nearby enemies.

skills.name: Sylvan Aid
skills.description: The blessings of the Sylph give you a leg-up against your enemies.

skills.name: Gust Shot
skills.description: Fire off a speeding arrow in a straight line.

skills.name: Trifling Wind I
skills.description:
Summons the Spirit of Wind to confuse nearby enemies. Soul energy appears in the direction the Wind Archer is facing, except when using certain skills. Attacks by always including the boss with the highest Max HP within range.
Unaffected by attack reflection.
Can be toggled On/Off.

skills.name: Spiraling Vortex
skills.description: Fires a spiraling shot that drives enemies back. Some monsters will resist and will not be driven back.

skills.name: Trifling Wind II
skills.description:
Summons the Spirit of Wind to greatly confuse enemies. Soul energy appears in the direction the Wind Archer is facing, except when using certain skills. Attacks by always including the boss with the highest Max HP within range.
Unaffected by attack reflection.

skills.name: Featherweight
skills.description: Your body becomes as light as a feather, gaining freedom from enemy attacks.

skills.name: Second Wind
skills.description: Borrow the power of wind, becoming more skillful at evasion. Being quick in battle gives a permanent Attack Power increase buff.

skills.name: Trifling Wind II
skills.description: Summons the Spirit of Wind to greatly confuse enemies.

skills.name: Eagle Eye
skills.description: Boosts your combat stats by mastering the power of the legendary Albatross.

skills.name: Sentient Arrow
skills.description: Creates a powerful gust using the emerald condensed with the power of wind as a medium to indiscriminately attack enemies on the left and right.

skills.name: Pinpoint Pierce
skills.description: Shoot off two arrows to strike the same enemy. Targets the boss with the highest Max HP within range.

skills.name: Emerald Flower
skills.description: Summons a green crystal flower that attracts and slows down nearby normal enemies. When an enemy intoxicated by the flower does not attack for a certain duration, they will break free from its control.

skills.name: Trifling Wind III
skills.description:
Summons the Spirit of Wind to utterly confound enemies, breaking down their bodies and minds. Soul energy appears in the direction the Wind Archer is facing, except when using certain skills. Attacks by always including the boss with the highest Max HP within range.
Unaffected by attack reflection.

skills.name: Touch of the Wind
skills.description: Become one with the wind through a divine blessing.

skills.name: Bow Expert
skills.description: Increases Bow Mastery, Attack Power, Final Damage, Critical Rate, and Boss Damage.

skills.name: Emerald Dust
skills.description: Enhances Emerald Flower to be more effective in battle.

skills.name: Albatross Max
skills.description: Borrows the power of the legendary Albatross. The passive effect is added to Eagle Eye.

skills.name: Trifling Wind III
skills.description: Summons the Spirit of Wind to utterly confound enemies, breaking down their bodies and minds.

skills.name: Trifling Wind - Reinforce
skills.description: Increases Trifling Wind's damage.

skills.name: Trifling Wind - Enhance
skills.description: Increases the chance to activate Trifling Wind.

skills.name: Trifling Wind - Double Chance
skills.description:
Doubles the soul energy created per enemy.
However, soul energy won't be created beyond the max limit. If the number of enemies that can be attacked is at max, soul energy will only double for one target.

skills.name: Fairy Spiral - Reinforce
skills.description: Increases Damage of Fairy Spiral.

skills.name: Fairy Spiral - Spread
skills.description: Increases the max number of enemies hit by Fairy Spiral.

skills.name: Fairy Spiral - Extra Strike
skills.description: Increases the number of attacks for Fairy Spiral.

skills.name: Song of Heaven - Reinforce
skills.description: Increases the damage of Song of Heaven.

skills.name: Song of Heaven - Guardbreak
skills.description: Increases Song of Heaven's Monster DEF debuff.

skills.name: Song of Heaven - Boss Rush
skills.description: Damage increases when attacking Boss Monsters with Song of Heaven.

skills.name: Call of Cygnus
skills.description: The Empress's blessing increases your stats. Using the skill briefly makes the Empress appear.

skills.name: Song of Heaven
skills.description: Play the song of the heavens to sweep away enemies. Can move while using this skill.

skills.name: Sharp Eyes
skills.description: Temporarily grants party members the ability to locate an enemy's weak spot to deal fatal damage to that enemy.

skills.name: Cygnus Knights' Will
skills.description:
Hones your resolve to ignore certain abnormal status effects. Immune to most abnormal status effects for 3 sec. after use. Certain abnormal status effects will still get through. Does not apply Combat Orders.
Can be used while using other skills.

skills.name: Fairy Spiral
skills.description: Swings the bow lightly in place as if dancing with the wind to create a strong gale that attacks enemies. Can be resisted by some enemies. Also boosts Sentient Arrow.

skills.name: Storm Bringer
skills.description:
Calls down a torrential storm on your enemies.
Unaffected by attack reflection.

skills.name: Monsoon
skills.description: Summons the seasonal winds to cover the world. The wind's blessing makes you temporarily invincible.

skills.name: Glory of the Guardians
skills.description: A ceremony for Cygnus Knights to pledge their devotion to the Empress.

skills.name: Storm Whim
skills.description:
The blessing of the Spirit of Wind temporarily allows you to control the power of the extreme storms.
Unaffected by attack reflection.

skills.name: Howling Gale
skills.description:
Summons a ferocious gust to punish your enemies.
Consumes 1 wind energy upon summoning. Using the skill with the down arrow key consumes 2 of your wind energy to summon a stronger gust. Using it with the up arrow key consumes 3 of your wind energy to summon 2 strong gusts, and you can resummon the gust to your position with the attack key.
The gust moves by continuously targeting the boss with the highest HP within the area, and reduces speed when attacking the enemy. There can only be 1 gust at a time, and it is unaffected by attack reflection.
Right-click to toggle speed reduction mode ON/OFF.

skills.name: Merciless Winds
skills.description:
Call upon the Spirit of Wind to conjure deadly homing projectiles that track down your foes. Can be used without a casting animation during Song of Heaven. The Spirit of Wind targets the boss with the highest HP first.
Unaffected by attack reflection.

skills.name: Gale Barrier
skills.description:
Activates a wind barrier around yourself. Creates a whirlwind when you attack with the Wind Blessing to deal additional damage.
Elemental is consumed upon defending against an attack and the wind barrier will disappear when it's completely consumed. The whirlwind is unaffected by attack reflection.

skills.name: Vortex Sphere
skills.description: Condense powerful winds into a sphere, then launch it in a slow, straight line. A gust occurs periodically with the Vortex Sphere at the center, pulling in surrounding enemies. Unaffected by attack reflection.

skills.name: HEXA Song of Heaven
skills.description: Plays the celestial song of the heavens to sweep away enemies. Can move while using this skill.

skills.name: HEXA Trifling Wind
skills.description:
Summons the Spirit of Wind to utterly confound enemies, breaking down their bodies and minds.
Soul energy appears in the direction the Wind Archer is facing, except when using certain skills.
Attacks by always including the boss with the highest Max HP within range and us unaffected by attack reflection.
Can be toggled On/Off.

skills.name: HEXA Trifling Wind
skills.description: Summons the Spirit of Wind to utterly confound enemies, breaking down their bodies and minds.

skills.name: HEXA Storm Bringer
skills.description:
Calls down a torrential storm on your enemies.
Unaffected by attack reflection. Increases Buff Duration.

skills.name: HEXA Fairy Spiral
skills.description: Swings the bow lightly in place, as if dancing with the wind, to create a strong gale that attacks enemies. Can be resisted by some enemies.

skills.name: HEXA Monsoon

skills.name: HEXA Storm Whim
skills.description:
The blessing of the Spirit of Wind temporarily allows you to control the power of the extreme storms.
Unaffected by attack reflection.

skills.name: Anemoi
skills.description:
Manifests an Anemoi, a Great Spirit of Wind, to call upon the winds of victory. The Anemoi attacks by summoning powerful gales at set intervals.
Unaffected by attack reflection.
Great Spirit Transparency On/Off: Right-click

skills.name: Anemoi
skills.description: Manifests an Anemoi, a Great Spirit of Wind, to call upon the winds of victory. The Anemoi attacks by summoning powerful gales at set intervals.

skills.name: Mistral Spring
skills.description:
A spring of wind bursts from the powerful emerald, drawing in any curious spirits that cross its path.
At regular intervals, the excited wind spirits ride the emerald's breeze to attack nearby enemies.
When there is a Wind Spring present, you can press the skill key re-summon it based on your current location.

Lv. 10: Ignore Defense +20%
Lv. 20: Boss Damage +20%
Lv. 30: Ignore Defense +30% and Boss Damage +30%

skills.name: Mistral Spring
skills.description:
A spring of wind bursts from the powerful emerald, drawing in any curious spirits that cross its path.
At regular intervals, the excited wind spirits ride the emerald's breeze to attack nearby enemies.
When there is a Wind Spring present, you can press the skill key re-summon it based on your current location.

skills.name: Elemental Tempest
skills.description:
Calls forth the tempest from your heart, first scouring enemies around you and then channeling the gale through Irena's bow, annihilating enemies in a deluge of arrows.

Lv. 10 - Ignore Defense: +10%, Boss Damage: +10%
Lv. 20 - Ignore Defense: +10%, Boss Damage: +10%
Lv. 30 - Ignore Defense: +20%
